title: Framer Audit
seo: Framer site audit and design review
meta: A clear review of your Framer site with a prioritized fix list and an optional 1-on-1 call. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Framer audit with a prioritized fix list
overview: We go through your Framer site as a visitor and as a builder. We check design consistency, mobile layouts, speed, search basics, forms, links and how the project is organized. You receive a written report that ranks every finding by importance, says why it matters and shows how to fix it. Standard and Premium add a video call where we walk through the results and answer your questions.

pkgs.blurb: A quick review of design, mobile layout and speed with ranked fixes.
Adds a search and structure review plus a call to discuss.
A deeper review with a conversion look, a roadmap and a re-check.

faq: Will you change my site during the audit?
No. The audit is read-only and nothing on your site is touched. You get a report and decide which items to act on, and we can quote the fixes as a separate order.
Your published site link is enough for the Basic review. For the project structure review, you invite us as a viewer on your Framer project. We never need your password.
Is an audit worth it for a small site?
Yes. Small sites often share the same quick wins, such as slow images, missing titles and clumsy mobile spacing, and these are cheap to fix once you know them.
We look at clarity, headings and the order of your message, not the facts in it. Rewriting the copy itself is a separate service we can quote.
